mapper.select: select COUNT(*) from favorites_like_record where user_id=#{userId} AND favorites_id=#{favoritesId}

select flr.favorites_id AS favoritesId, f.user_id AS userId, f.favorite_name AS favoritesName, u.username AS userName, f.like_count AS likeCount, f.look_count As lookCount
FROM favorites_like_record flr JOIN favorites f ON f.favorite_id=flr.favorites_id JOIN user u ON u.user_id=f.user_id where flr.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from favorites_like_record where favorites_id=#{favoritesId} AND user_id=#{userId}
